Learned counsel for the appellants has filed a memo which states as follows:
The Appellant counsel herewith submits that, since the Insurance Appeal was remanded to the trial court in connected matter.
This above appeal not survive for the time being.
However the appellant seeks liberty to participate in the Trial Court as well as seeking liberty to approach this court after disposal before the trial Court.
Hence this memo in the interest of justice and equity.
2. In view of the memo dated 09.07.2025, present appeal is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as aforementioned.
